lines.zh: 我用巨大的鳍切开海水，像划过夜空。
lines.en: I cut the water with huge fins, like crossing the night sky.

lines.zh: 蓝紫色的身体上，星纹一路拖在身后。
lines.en: Star patterns trail behind my blue-violet body.

lines.zh: 鲸鱼也要让开，我的影子比它长。
lines.en: Even whales make way; my shadow is longer than theirs.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，因为深海不值得急。
lines.en: I swim slowly; the deep sea is not worth hurrying.

lines.zh: 尾鳍一摆，水里的光就跟着转。
lines.en: One tail sweep, and the light in the water turns.

lines.zh: 头顶的光斑，是我自己带的星图。
lines.en: The spots above me are a star chart I carry.

lines.zh: 鱼群散开，为我留出一条路。
lines.en: The school of fish parts to leave me a path.

lines.zh: 我从海沟上方漂过，下面全是黑。
lines.en: I drift over the trench, where everything below is black.

lines.zh: 我的胸鳍张到最宽，像两面帆。
lines.en: My pectoral fins spread wide like two sails.

lines.zh: 这片海洋太大，我只走熟悉的水道。
lines.en: This ocean is vast; I keep to familiar channels.

lines.zh: 星纹在水里亮了一下，又暗下去。
lines.en: My star patterns glow once in the water, then fade.

lines.zh: 我贴着海面游，月亮就在背上。
lines.en: I swim near the surface with the moon on my back.

lines.zh: 海豚绕开我，它们知道我饿了。
lines.en: Dolphins steer clear of me; they know I am hungry.

lines.zh: 大鳍扇起暗流，把沙都掀起来。
lines.en: My fins stir dark currents and lift the sand.

lines.zh: 我绕过海底的岩柱，很慢。
lines.en: I round the seabed pillars, slowly.

lines.zh: 我的星纹在水里留了一道痕。
lines.en: My star pattern leaves a trace in the water.

lines.zh: 我悬在深蓝里，像一颗不肯坠的星。
lines.en: I hang in deep blue, a star that will not fall.

lines.zh: 呼吸很慢，鳃里流过的水带着光。
lines.en: My gills pass water that glows, and I breathe slowly.

lines.zh: 很久没人见过我，我习惯这样。
lines.en: Few have ever seen me, and I am used to that.

lines.zh: 身上的旋纹在暗处更清楚。
lines.en: The swirls on my body are clearer in the dark.

lines.zh: 我在等一群天蓝色的水母经过。
lines.en: I wait for a shoal of sky-blue jellyfish to pass.

lines.zh: 大鳍垂着，我几乎不花力气。
lines.en: My big fins hang loose, and I spend almost no effort.

lines.zh: 海底的沙子发白，我看了很久。
lines.en: The seabed sand glows white, and I watch it long.

lines.zh: 我的黑眼睛映着水面的碎光。
lines.en: My black eyes reflect broken light from the surface.

lines.zh: 安静时，我能听见远处的水流。
lines.en: When it is quiet, I hear currents far away.

lines.zh: 天鱼不需要巢，整片海都是。
lines.en: A celestial needs no nest; the whole sea is one.

lines.zh: 我把身体横过来，让星纹受光。
lines.en: I turn my body sideways so the star marks catch light.

lines.zh: 有一阵子，我以为自己会浮上去。
lines.en: For a while I thought I might float upward.

lines.zh: 深水里没有季节，只有盐和夜。
lines.en: The deep has no seasons, only salt and night.

lines.zh: 我数水母的光，一只，两只。
lines.en: I count jellyfish lights: one, then two.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，我在水下看你。
lines.en: You stand on shore; I watch from below.

lines.zh: 你身上的光很弱，我勉强看得见。
lines.en: Your light is faint, and I barely make you out.

lines.zh: 你俯身时，我和你的倒影对上眼。
lines.en: As you lean down, I meet your reflection's eye.

lines.zh: 我游近水面，只为看清你的脸。
lines.en: I rise to the surface just to see your face.

lines.zh: 你不该在这个浅处看到我。
lines.en: You should not be seeing me this shallow.

lines.zh: 我转过来，星纹对着你的方向。
lines.en: I turn so my star marks face your direction.

lines.zh: 你的火把把海水照成了别的颜色。
lines.en: Your torch turns the seawater a different color.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，像盯一颗刚出现的星。
lines.en: I stare at you as at a newly appeared star.

lines.zh: 你后退了，很好，我还在看。
lines.en: You step back; good, I am still watching.

lines.zh: 浮上来的气泡挡在我和你之间。
lines.en: Bubbles rise and hang between you and me.

lines.zh: 我的星纹被砍出一道暗痕。
lines.en: A dark cut crosses my star marks.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，变成紫色。
lines.en: My blood spreads through the water and turns violet.

lines.zh: 这一下很重，我下沉了几格。
lines.en: That blow was heavy, and I sank a few blocks.

lines.zh: 四十几点的身体也会疼。
lines.en: Even a body with forty health can hurt.

lines.zh: 我偏过头，缺了一块鳍。
lines.en: I turn away, missing a piece of fin.

lines.zh: 你砍中的地方，旋纹断开了。
lines.en: Where you struck, the swirl pattern breaks.

lines.zh: 水压忽然变大，我的伤口在响。
lines.en: The pressure shifts, and my wound makes a sound.

lines.zh: 我没想到浅水里也有危险。
lines.en: I did not expect danger in shallow water.

lines.zh: 疼让我想起自己不是真正的星。
lines.en: Pain reminds me I am not truly a star.

lines.zh: 我退进暗处，让水替我止血。
lines.en: I withdraw into the dark and let water stop the bleeding.

lines.zh: 水母的蓝光飘过来，我的鳍先动了。
lines.en: Jellyfish glow drifts near, and my fins move first.

lines.zh: 我不吃面包，我只吃会发光的东西。
lines.en: I do not eat bread; I eat things that glow.

lines.zh: 你把鱼丢下来，我等它沉到深一点。
lines.en: You toss a fish; I wait for it to sink deeper.

lines.zh: 那道光在动，我的瞳孔跟着缩。
lines.en: That light moves, and my pupils narrow after it.

lines.zh: 饥饿让我游得比平时靠上。
lines.en: Hunger pulls me higher up the water column.

lines.zh: 你手里的灯笼，比鱼更像晚餐。
lines.en: The lantern in your hand looks more like dinner.

lines.zh: 我不追诱饵，我追诱饵的影子。
lines.en: I chase not the bait but the bait's shadow.

lines.zh: 一群水母聚在礁后，我已经闻到电。
lines.en: A jellyfish swarm gathers behind the reef; I smell current.

lines.zh: 你把食物举高，我只看见光在晃。
lines.en: You raise the food; I only see the light sway.

lines.zh: 别用鱼饵试探我，我一口能连钩吞下。
lines.en: Do not test me with bait; I swallow hook and all.

lines.zh: 你整个人撞进我的身侧，弹开了。
lines.en: You crash into my flank and bounce off.

lines.zh: 我的身体很沉，水也推不动我。
lines.en: My body is heavy, and even water cannot push it.

lines.zh: 胸鳍扫过你，留下白色的水痕。
lines.en: My fin sweeps you and leaves a white wake.

lines.zh: 船底碰到我，木头发出一声闷响。
lines.en: Your hull meets me, and the wood gives a dull groan.

lines.zh: 你退开时，我的星纹蹭到了你。
lines.en: As you pull away, my star marks brush against you.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，海水先让开了一圈。
lines.en: We collide, and the seawater first makes room.

lines.zh: 别贴太近，我的鳍边缘很硬。
lines.en: Do not come close; my fin edges are hard.

lines.zh: 我轻轻一摆尾，你就被推远了。
lines.en: One light tail beat pushes you away.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我眼睛发花。
lines.en: This collision leaves my eyes swimming with sparks.

lines.zh: 我们都停住，水里浮着细沙。
lines.en: We both stop, fine sand floating in the water.

lines.zh: 另一条天鱼来了，海水突然变亮。
lines.en: Another celestial arrives, and the water brightens.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，星纹拼成一整片夜空。
lines.en: We swim abreast, star marks joining into one night sky.

lines.zh: 它的光比我的冷，正合我意。
lines.en: Its light is colder than mine, which suits me.

lines.zh: 我们绕着彼此转，像两个慢下来的星系。
lines.en: We circle each other like two slowing galaxies.

lines.zh: 天鱼极少相遇，所以每次都算节日。
lines.en: Celestials rarely meet, so every meeting is a festival.

lines.zh: 它用胸鳍碰我，海水抖了一下。
lines.en: Its fin touches mine, and the water shivers.

lines.zh: 我们把卵放在没有洋流的深处。
lines.en: We place our eggs in depths without currents.

lines.zh: 不用争，这片海域足够两条天鱼。
lines.en: No need to fight; this water holds two celestials.

lines.zh: 它先走了，光还留在水里。
lines.en: It leaves first, but its light stays in the water.

lines.zh: 下次相遇，可能要好几年。
lines.en: Our next meeting could be years from now.

lines.zh: 我没有能拿东西的手，只有鳍。
lines.en: I have no hands for holding, only fins.

lines.zh: 你丢的东西沉不到我嘴边。
lines.en: Whatever you drop never sinks to my mouth.

lines.zh: 我用嘴含住一块礁石，又吐出来。
lines.en: I hold a piece of reef in my mouth, then spit it.

lines.zh: 那枚海晶碎片反光，我盯着它。
lines.en: That prismarine shard glints, and I stare at it.

lines.zh: 沉船里的箱子，我用身体撞开。
lines.en: I break open a shipwreck chest with my body.

lines.zh: 我拿不走，只能用尾巴扫到一边。
lines.en: I cannot take it, so I sweep it aside with my tail.

lines.zh: 你递来的鱼，我一口连水吞了。
lines.en: The fish you offer goes down with a mouthful of water.

lines.zh: 光落在我鳍上，我甩不掉。
lines.en: Light lands on my fin, and I cannot shake it off.

lines.zh: 我拖着渔网游了一段，又放开。
lines.en: I drag a fishing net a while, then let it go.

lines.zh: 海底的东西都太沉，我懒得带。
lines.en: Everything on the seabed is too heavy to bother with.

lines.zh: 水母的电流在响，我转头。
lines.en: A jellyfish's current hums, and I turn my head.

lines.zh: 一条受伤的鱼在礁边抽动。
lines.en: A wounded fish twitches by the reef.

lines.zh: 我锁定了那团蓝光，别的都暗了。
lines.en: I lock onto that blue glow; everything else dims.

lines.zh: 你落水的声音，比水母还清楚。
lines.en: The sound of you falling in is clearer than jellyfish.

lines.zh: 很远的光点开始移动，我出发了。
lines.en: A distant light begins to move, and I set off.

lines.zh: 我闻到的不是血，是电。
lines.en: What I smell is not blood but current.

lines.zh: 天鱼很少扑空，因为选得慢。
lines.en: Celestials rarely miss because they choose slowly.

lines.zh: 那片水域忽然安静，我知道它在。
lines.en: The water suddenly quiets; I know it is there.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，从下方接近。
lines.en: I lower my body and approach from below.

lines.zh: 目标是一只水母，也是一盏灯。
lines.en: The target is a jellyfish and also a lamp.

lines.zh: 我沿着你的影子游，越绕越紧。
lines.en: I swim along your shadow, tightening the loop.

lines.zh: 水把你的心跳一声声送过来。
lines.en: The water delivers your heartbeat, beat by beat.

lines.zh: 我不急着咬，我在等你的手放下。
lines.en: I do not bite yet; I wait for your hand to lower.

lines.zh: 每绕一圈，我的星纹就亮一分。
lines.en: Each circle makes my star marks a little brighter.

lines.zh: 你往左，我就封住左边。
lines.en: You go left, and I close off the left.

lines.zh: 我的黑眼睛没有表情，你放心。
lines.en: My black eyes show nothing; rest assured.

lines.zh: 水流告诉我你在发抖。
lines.en: The current tells me that you are trembling.

lines.zh: 这一片海都是我的猎场。
lines.en: This whole stretch of sea is my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 我先不动，让你以为我走了。
lines.en: I hold still first, letting you think I left.

lines.zh: 等你转身，我的大鳍已经张开。
lines.en: When you turn, my great fins are already spread.

lines.zh: 我用额头撞过去，水被挤开。
lines.en: I strike with my forehead, and the water splits.

lines.zh: 一口咬下去，连光都被咬断。
lines.en: One bite, and even the light is bitten through.

lines.zh: 我的牙不长，但颌骨很沉。
lines.en: My teeth are not long, but my jaw is heavy.

lines.zh: 你被扫中，像被一扇门拍倒。
lines.en: You are swept aside as if by a slamming door.

lines.zh: 星纹在攻击时全亮起来。
lines.en: My star marks all flare when I attack.

lines.zh: 这一下带着深海的凉。
lines.en: This blow carries the cold of the deep.

lines.zh: 我撞碎了你脚边的礁石。
lines.en: I shatter the reef rock beside your feet.

lines.zh: 别以为我慢，我的冲刺很短。
lines.en: Do not think me slow; my charge is short and sudden.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的护甲，甩了甩头。
lines.en: I bite your armor and shake my head.

lines.zh: 打完这一下，我又沉回暗处。
lines.en: After this blow I sink back into the dark.

lines.zh: 海里偶尔会出现一颗新的星。
lines.en: Now and then a new star appears in the sea.

lines.zh: 我生成得很稀少，整片海只容一两条。
lines.en: I spawn rarely; this sea holds only one or two.

lines.zh: 深水的压力把我压成这样的形状。
lines.en: Deep pressure pressed me into this shape.

lines.zh: 星纹是在第一次涨潮时亮起的。
lines.en: My star marks lit up with the first high tide.

lines.zh: 我从一片没有光的海水里浮出来。
lines.en: I rise out of a patch of water without light.

lines.zh: 没有刷怪蛋，谁也没法轻易叫我出来。
lines.en: No spawn egg exists, so no one calls me easily.

lines.zh: 我出生时，附近的水母全散了。
lines.en: When I was born, the nearby jellyfish all scattered.

lines.zh: 两条一起出现，已经算很热闹。
lines.en: Two of us appearing at once is already a crowd.

lines.zh: 海洋给了我四十点命，够用了。
lines.en: The ocean gave me forty health, which is enough.

lines.zh: 我的第一顿饭，是一只发光的水母。
lines.en: My first meal was a jellyfish that glowed.

lines.zh: 火焰在水下也能烫穿我的鳍。
lines.en: Even underwater, fire burns through my fins.

lines.zh: 我被冲上浅滩，身体砸在沙上。
lines.en: I am washed onto the shallows and slam into sand.

lines.zh: 离开水，我的鳃像被掐住。
lines.en: Out of water, my gills feel clamped shut.

lines.zh: 冲击把我整条掀翻过来。
lines.en: The blast rolls me over, fins pointing up.

lines.zh: 箭在水中慢下来，还是扎进我。
lines.en: The arrow slows in water and still sticks in me.

lines.zh: 咒语在我星纹间乱窜。
lines.en: Magic races wildly between my star marks.

lines.zh: 水母越来越难找，光也暗了。
lines.en: Jellyfish grow scarce, and my light dims.

lines.zh: 雷落进海里，我全身的星纹一缩。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sea, and all my star marks flinch.

lines.zh: 我坠出水面，最后看见的是星。
lines.en: I fall out of the sea, seeing stars at last.
